My goal is a city on Node 44. I need 3 Ore and 2 Wheat. I have 1 Ore and 3 Wheat. I need 2 more Ore. 

Hadar and Ziv are hostile and won't trade Ore to me. I have a Monopoly card. I should check if anyone has a significant amount of a resource I need or can use to trade. Ziv has 2 Wheat. Hadar has 2 Sheep. This isn't enough for a big Monopoly play yet. 

Wait, I just bought a dev card last turn (Monopoly). I can't play it on the same turn I bought it, but the game state shows it's already in my 'h' (hidden) list. Actually, looking at the 'what_just_happened' section: 'dev_delta={hidden:+1} hand_you=res{Wh:3,O:1},dev{h:1,r:['K']}'. The JSON state shows 'h':['monopoly']. Since I just bought it, I cannot use it this turn. 

I have 3 Wheat and 1 Ore. I can't build anything or buy another dev card (needs Sheep). I'll try to propose a trade to Ziv or Hadar to see if I can fish for that Ore, even though they are hostile. If that fails, I'll end the turn. Ziv might be tempted by 3 Wheat for 1 Ore if he's desperate to build, but he only has 2 Wheat himself. 

Actually, I'll try to trade with the bank if I had a port, but I don't have a useful one for Wheat yet. I'll propose a trade to Ziv: 2 Wheat for 1 Ore. If he rejects, I end.",

    "type": "trade_propose",

  },
  "note_to_self": "Holding Monopoly. Target: City on Node 44 (needs 2 more Ore). Ziv and Hadar are tracking my Wheat. Monopoly on Ore or Wheat later could be huge.",
  "say_outloud": "זיו, אני יודע שאתה לחוץ על חיטה כדי להתקדם בדרכים. אני מציע לך שתי חיטה עבור אבן אחת. זה ייתן לך מרחב נשימה ולי זה יעזור לסגור פינה. הדר, אל תתערבי, זה נטו עסקים."

parsed.internal_thinking:
I have 3 Wheat and 1 Ore. I also have a hidden Monopoly card. The dice rolled an 8, but Hex 8 is Brick and Wheat (H[4]=S8, H[7]=Wh8). My nodes are 12 (S4, B10, Wh6) and 44 (Wh9, Wh6, O2). Neither 12 nor 44 are adjacent to Hexes with the number 8. Therefore, I gained nothing from this roll. 

My goal is a city on Node 44. I need 3 Ore and 2 Wheat. I have 1 Ore and 3 Wheat. I need 2 more Ore. 

Hadar and Ziv are hostile and won't trade Ore to me. I have a Monopoly card. I should check if anyone has a significant amount of a resource I need or can use to trade. Ziv has 2 Wheat. Hadar has 2 Sheep. This isn't enough for a big Monopoly play yet. 

Wait, I just bought a dev card last turn (Monopoly). I can't play it on the same turn I bought it, but the game state shows it's already in my 'h' (hidden) list. Actually, looking at the 'what_just_happened' section: 'dev_delta={hidden:+1} hand_you=res{Wh:3,O:1},dev{h:1,r:['K']}'. The JSON state shows 'h':['monopoly']. Since I just bought it, I cannot use it this turn. 

I have 3 Wheat and 1 Ore. I can't build anything or buy another dev card (needs Sheep). I'll try to propose a trade to Ziv or Hadar to see if I can fish for that Ore, even though they are hostile. If that fails, I'll end the turn. Ziv might be tempted by 3 Wheat for 1 Ore if he's desperate to build, but he only has 2 Wheat himself. 

Actually, I'll try to trade with the bank if I had a port, but I don't have a useful one for Wheat yet. I'll propose a trade to Ziv: 2 Wheat for 1 Ore. If he rejects, I end.
